payload.text: **EVERY ACT THAT CHANGES THE DISK IS RECORDED**, and when this row was written none was. `Facade::apply` is the single door for MODEL mutation and everything reaching it is logged; `Facade::organize`, `sync_to_disk`, `sync_from_disk` and `hydrate` each write the filesystem without passing it, and record through `Facade::record_disk_act` instead. **Measured 2026-08-19: `organize --apply` removed 423 files from this estate and the log recorded nothing** -- the only act all evening that destroyed anything is the only class of act absent from the one table that cannot be re-derived from anything else on disk. The realisation ops emit against the same `Store::append_event`, **with the subject being the PATH SET rather than an artefact id**. Denominator printed: realisation ops that emit, against realisation ops that write. **NOT BY ROUTING `organize` THROUGH `apply`** -- `apply` diffs canon and `organize` changes no canon, so the event would be a lie about its own mechanism.
